summary: A real BB browser showed canonical five-hour and weekly rows followed by Fable with its percentage and explicit reset state, while the compact control remained one configured percentage. Dialog relationships and Open/Close copy were state-accurate; focus moved to close on open and returned to the trigger on close/Escape. Refresh kept focus on its aria-disabled control throughout the request. Escape closed details only while focus belonged to Usage Tracker and left a host-focused layer to BB. A 14-row narrow-card pass kept the header above host chrome, wrapped a long label, exposed one labeled focusable scroll region, used vertical scrolling, and had no horizontal overflow.
collector: bb browser live Usage Tracker verification
